data.one_liner: A Changelog manipulation library for reading, modifying, and writing CHANGELOG.md files.
data.what_it_does: Provides CRUD operations on releases and changes for CHANGELOG.md files following the keepachangelog format. Supports basic Markdown syntax and semantic versioning.
use_when: You need to programmatically read or update CHANGELOG.md files in your Dart or Flutter project
Your project strictly follows the keepachangelog format
avoid_when: Your changelog uses complex Markdown structures like tables, nested lists, or HTML
You use a changelog format other than keepachangelog
strengths: Simple API for reading and modifying changelogs
Supports basic Markdown syntax and semantic versioning
weaknesses: Limited strictly to the keepachangelog format
Complex Markdown features are not supported
